head: CameraStamp shoots through modeled film stocks in real time
dek: CameraStamp lets you shoot photos through modeled film stocks and old TV tube cameras, each with its own grain and colour, and saves what you see straight to your library. It was #77 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 4 November.
details: It also hosts audio plugins for the sound of your videos. It costs $4.99 with in-app purchases, by The Musicology Group.
means: If you like the film look without editing afterwards, it applies it while you shoot.
todo: Find CameraStamp in the App Store.
